test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: Tropic of Cancer passes through which of the following states?
solution:
**The correct answer is __Jharkhand.__**

The Tropic of Cancer passes through these 8 states in India:** Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] __Important Points__**

__
 
• Tropic of Cancer is an imaginary line, at an angle of 23.50 degrees North from the Equator, passes through 17 countries, India being one of them.
 
• The Tropic of Cancer (23° 30'N) divides the country into almost two equal parts.
 
• The Tropic of Cancer passes through eight states in India: **Gujarat (Jasdan), Rajasthan (Kalinjarh), Madhya Pradesh (Shajapur), Chhattisgarh (Sunhat), Jharkhand (Lohardaga), West Bengal (Krishnanagar), Tripura (Udaipur) and Mizoram (Champhai)**. **Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahi Rive**r is the only river in India that cuts the Tropic of Cancer twice, first in Madhya Pradesh from where it flows towards Rajasthan and enters Gujarat where it cuts for the second time.
 
• During Summer Solstice, that is, June 21, the sun falls perpendicularly on the Tropic of Cancer.
